name: com.arp.androidrootprotector
description:
Server-authoritative tamper and root detection for Quest/Android games on PlayFab. Detects patched APKs and mod loaders via the Meta Attestation API and build checksums, detects compromised headsets via local device checks, and enforces bans through PlayFab CloudScript.

DEV TEST BUILD - nothing here has been tested beyond compiling. Run enforcementMode as FlagForReview.
